$schema_notes: sk3o in-game console command reference. Grouped by subsystem/source file. 'kind' distinguishes real commands from UI-only affordances and standalone notes.

commands.name: help
commands.description: Lists these built-ins plus every registered command below.

commands.name: echo
commands.description: Prints <text> back.

commands.name: input_log
commands.description: Toggle logging of raw input events into the console. Off by default; can get noisy.

commands.name: skater
commands.description: Print the local skater's live entity address + world position.

commands.name: entities
commands.description: Class counts (live/total) plus live entity rows with position where readable. class filters to one of base/lw/skater/colorized/cac/skater-aux (omit for all); max limits rows shown (default 40).

commands.name: entity_info
commands.description: Full spawn-time register snapshot for one entity (lr, r3, r5-r10).

commands.name: entity_set_pos
commands.description: One-shot WRITE of a live entity's world position (entity+416 translation). First game-state mutation this project ever did; confirmed to have no visible effect (see entity_freeze_pos).

commands.name: entity_freeze_pos
commands.description: Like entity_set_pos but re-applies every host frame while the console/entities window is open. Also confirmed no visible effect - see docs/sk3o/research.json (entity+416/+352 are downstream animation outputs, not renderer inputs).

commands.name: entity_unfreeze_pos
commands.description: Stop a freeze started by entity_freeze_pos.

commands.name: entity_dump
commands.description: Raw 4-byte words from a guest address, annotated with heap/stack/code pointer-range guesses.

commands.name: entity_diff
commands.description: Snapshot an entity's raw words; call again on the same address to diff against the stored snapshot and print only what changed. The tool that found the 7-slot table and the position-palette fields.

commands.name: scan
commands.description: Memory-scanner family, Cheat-Engine-style value scanning over a guest address range.

commands.name: probe
commands.description: Install a runtime probe on an address. Only works for confirmed-indirect/bctrl targets, not direct bl calls - see meta.call_dispatch in research.json.

commands.name: test_candidates
commands.description: Informational only; lists functions being considered for direct invocation and what's still missing before that's safe. Calls nothing.

commands.name: spawn_caller
commands.description: Last-call snapshot (caller address + r3-r10) for a traced function. Omit name to list every tracked function.

commands.name: spawn_trace
commands.description: Ordered, timestamped log of every call to any traced function while on (also toggleable via the "Trace spawn calls" checkbox in the console window). Turning on clears the log first.

commands.name: spawn_trace_mute
commands.description: Stop <name> from being written to the ordered log (its spawn_caller snapshot still updates). sub_8243AEE8 and sub_827690A8 are muted by default (confirmed noise generators).

commands.name: spawn_trace_unmute
commands.description: Reverse spawn_trace_mute.

commands.name: spawn_trace_mutelist
commands.description: Show currently muted names.

commands.name: Traced functions
commands.description: Currently traced functions (usable with spawn_caller/mute commands): sub_82808E30, sub_82768360, sub_827681D0, sub_82769478, sub_827690A8, sub_827649A0, sub_82765EC0, sub_82765DE8, sub_8275D900, sub_8243AEE8.

commands.name: natives
commands.description: List the confirmed native catalog (currently empty - nothing's been promoted from research into a confirmed, safe-to-call native yet).

commands.name: spawn_guest
commands.description: Placeholder pending a confirmed skater-spawn native; currently just reports whether SKATER_LOCAL_GET resolved.

commands.name: F8
commands.description: Toggle the console.

commands.name: Entities button
commands.description: Opens the entity window.

commands.name: Trace spawn calls checkbox
commands.description: Same as spawn_trace on/off.
